result.summary: All 8 validation checks PASSED for SH-01 through SH-04. SH-01: 4 E2E tests (TC-SH01-01..04) cover login form render, valid-token login, 401 error, empty-field error; 7 unit tests (TC-SH01-U01..U07) cover decodeTokenPayload branches. SH-02: 2 E2E tests (TC-SH02-01..02) cover auth:session-expired event and direct URL nav; session-expired banner asserted in both. SH-03: 3 E2E tests (TC-SH03-01..03) cover TASK_WORKER (My Tasks only), PLATFORM_ADMIN (all 11 items), PROCESS_DESIGNER (2 items); absent items checked with not.toBeAttached() confirming items are NOT in DOM (hidden, not disabled). SH-04: 3 E2E tests (TC-SH04-01..03) + 5 unit tests (TC-SH04-U01..U05) cover display_name, roles display, and logout flow. No test.skip/describe.skip/it.skip found. No MSW, axios-mock-adapter, jest.mock, or vi.mock — only page.route() for /health/ready stub (acceptable). Unit tests import only from ../tokenUtils and @/types/api; no backend dependency. Each E2E test calls loginWith() per-test, installing page.route() fresh — no shared mutable global state.
